name: PhotoToGIF
tagline: Make a GIF from multiple photos in your browser
description: PhotoToGIF is a browser tool that turns still photos into GIFs. The multi-photo GIF editor is free and needs no account. AI animation is a separate paid option: a $9 one-time pack for 180 AI credits, valid 90 days, not a subscription. New accounts get 10 free credits for the AI features. It runs in the browser; no app install is required.
